headline: Insilico releases Longevity Grok, a multi-agent system for longitudinal health data
summary: Insilico Medicine announced Longevity Grok / Personal Longevity Superintelligence, a Grok Bot-based system described as organizing longitudinal personal health records, tracking biomarkers, proposing lifestyle interventions and scoring follow-up results. Current repository documentation describes optional sharing under a random contributor code and acknowledges residual re-identification risk; the README also warns outputs are automated, not clinically reviewed and may be wrong. Product capabilities and data handling remain unverified in operation; this review did not establish clinical benefit.
